newsitem.title: USA: Kent Electronics sees Q2 EPS $0.24 to $0.25.
newsitem.headline: Kent Electronics sees Q2 EPS $0.24 to $0.25.

text.p: Kent Electronics Corp said on Thursday it expects lower second quarter earnings per share of $0.24 to $0.25 for the period ending September 28, 1996, reflecting weakness in electronics manufacturing and distribution.
The company is expecting revenues between $100 million and $106 million for the period, it said.
In last year's second quarter, the company posted revenues of $90 million and net income of $6 million, or $0.29 a share, Kent Electronics said.
Kent Electronics said it has cut senior management compensation and it is cutting staff to reduce costs.
The company said it expects to at least maintain second quarter earnings levels through the third and fourth quarters.
The extent of the cuts in management compensation and employees was not immediately available.
